messages:
sam (Finance): Heads-up — Aurora Clinics opened a billing dispute on their Nov invoice. Platform fee duplicated and support-tier proration not reflected. Can Billing/CS triage?

lina (AE): I flagged this in SF (ORD-94412). They moved from Private+ to Private on 2024-07-05. Renewal cycle is 2024-11-01. Invoice INV-562210 shows both PLATFORM-FEE-PRIVPLUS and PLATFORM-FEE-PRIV.

meera (Billing): Pulling INV-562210 now. System created two platform fee lines; looks like the order change wasn't honored during the monthly billing run.

owen (CS): Customer email thread in CS-2410 shows they requested immediate downgrade on 2024-07-05. They pasted the signed amendment.

kai (Eng Ops): Noted: deployment aurora-main had reserved capacity tags set to the old plan until 2024-10-31 due to delayed infra rollout. Usage shows capacity scaled down 2024-11-01. So billing engine saw old plan through Oct.

sam (Finance): So overlap months are Aug-Oct. Customer is asking for a full true-up credit for that window. What's the amount?

meera (Billing): Running pro-rate now. Need ORD-94412 and exact SOW effective date.

lina (AE): Order in SF: ORD-94412, amendment signed 2024-07-05.

meera (Billing): Calc done — overlap platform fee billed = $32,160. There are additional small overcharges on support add-ons ($540). Total disputed = $32,700.

lina (AE): Can we propose partial credit to keep renewal smooth? Recommend $30k credit and note $2,700 to be reviewed.

sam (Finance): I can approve one-time credits up to $25k. Above that needs director sign-off. Please prepare a reconciliation and a short rationale for approval.

meera (Billing): I'll prepare reconciliation sheet and proposed credit memo. Tentative CM-AUR-2024-009 for $30,000 if approved. Will flag remaining $2,700 as pending.

kai (Eng Ops): I'll create INF-689 to ensure order state changes push immediately to the billing sync job. ETA patch deploy 2024-11-08. Also will add an alert when reserved capacity tags diverge from order state.

owen (CS): I'll message the customer offering a $30k credit while we investigate the remaining $2,700. Will ask for acceptance in writing.

lina (AE): Noted — account team will also hold renewal call on 2024-11-02 and mention ops fix timeline.

sam (Finance): OK — I'll escalate approval for the $30k credit to finance director now (doc link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-APPR-211). If approved, Billing Meera to post CM and update INV-562210. GL to use rev_acct 4002 and memo 'aurora onprem true-up goodwill 2024'.

meera (Billing): Uploaded reconciliation to billing drive and linked ORD-94412. Creating approval package now.

billing-bot: Approval request FIN-APPR-211 created and assigned to director.

sam (Finance): Thanks everyone. Please keep thread updated when credit posts and when INF-689 deploys.

meera (Billing): Will post CM number here once created.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-AUR-2024-009 pending director approval for amount $30,000.

sam (Finance): Closing interim — will reopen if director denies.
